layers.name: foundation
layers.purpose: Dependency-light value contracts and hostname policy shared by every higher layer.

layers.name: engine
layers.purpose: Bounded deterministic provider, fetch, evidence, JSON-selection, and offline-evaluation engines without Harness lifecycle dependencies.

layers.name: harness
layers.purpose: DeepSeek Harness tool definitions, lifecycle policy, orchestration, presentation, and adapter code.

layers.name: cli
layers.purpose: Non-Harness command entry points that may call bounded engines but not plugin adapters.

layers.name: composition
layers.purpose: Public package export surface and plugin composition root.

size_exceptions.reason: HTML normalization, text extraction, claim attribution, and excerpt assembly are still colocated.

size_exceptions.removal_condition: Remove this exception when every resulting production module is at or below the default module budget.

size_exceptions.reason: Lossless number scanning, exact decimal comparison, request validation, and selection remain in one engine.
size_exceptions.next_extraction: Extract shared strict-JSON and RFC 6901 primitives without weakening module-specific error codes.
size_exceptions.removal_condition: Remove this exception after shared primitives are extracted and the selector is within the default budget.

size_exceptions.reason: Strict parsing, pointer repair audits, nested projection, and output budgeting are still colocated.
size_exceptions.next_extraction: Extract shared strict-JSON and pointer-resolution primitives, then isolate nested projection.
size_exceptions.removal_condition: Remove this exception when the projection engine and extracted modules each satisfy the default budget.

size_exceptions.reason: Strict JSON validation, date normalization, pointer resolution, and maximum-tie selection are colocated.
size_exceptions.next_extraction: Move shared strict-JSON, ISO-date, and RFC 6901 utilities into engine-layer modules.

size_exceptions.reason: Corpus contract parsing, integrity verification, operation dispatch, assertions, and reporting are colocated.
size_exceptions.next_extraction: Separate corpus parsing/integrity from operation execution before adding another evaluated capability.

size_exceptions.removal_condition: Remove this exception when the network policy and transport modules each satisfy the default budget.

size_exceptions.reason: Request validation, lane execution, source fetching, claim attribution, aggregation, formatting, and Harness tool definition are colocated.

size_exceptions.removal_condition: Remove this exception after orchestration is split into bounded modules and no production module exceeds the default budget.
